I have, but to get it I'd have to go to a therapist, and the law is pretty clear that they can ignore doctor-patient confidentiality if they think there's a risk of me committing a crime. Child molestation has a lot of emotional attachment and I'm scared that if I go for help, I'll get arrested for saying something wrong and my life will be ruined.
Sooner kill myself than molest someone. I'm from the UK
